$doc: M0-X: cross-system replication probe on USDCAD 4h (doc 37 v2). Multipliers over the ANCHOR'S OWN baseline LR 3.559e-4 (Musashi correction 1); single verified anchor seed2703 reused across all four seeds — declared limitation; the smoke champion is REJECTED (zero trades). Runs only AFTER M1 resolves easy causality; if M1 says lr_only, M0-X conclusions attribute nothing to easy. Outcome set includes INCONCLUSIVE; a replication concludes 'not falsified in a second system', never 'universal mechanism'.

precondition_gate.anchor_validation_activity_reproof: must re-measure >0 validation trades before any arm

single_anchor_limitation: one verified anchor for all seeds; seed variation measures fine-tune stochasticity, not anchor diversity
validation_contract: USDCAD's own frozen splits from the anchor lineage; its test split forbidden

interpretation.not_falsified: the M1-established pattern repeats on USDCAD in >=3/4 seeds
interpretation.conditioned: the pattern fails on USDCAD: mechanism is system-conditioned; R3 bounds become per-asset
interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: gate failures, unverifiable records, anchor activity below reproof threshold, or mixed cells meeting no rule: no conclusion, escalate

forbidden: attributing anything to easy if M1 concluded lr_only
